legal_marketplace_terms_subtitle.en: My Farmer — order intermediary, not a payment service

legal_terms_footer.en: By using the My Farmer marketplace you accept these terms. Contact app support with questions. We recommend reviewing these terms periodically.
legal_terms_footer.hr: Korištenjem tržnice My Farmer prihvaćate ove uvjete. Za pitanja kontaktirajte podršku aplikacije. Preporučujemo da ove uvjete povremeno pregledate.

legal_terms_role_body.en: My Farmer is a digital platform for listing products, placing orders, and communication between buyers and sellers (farmers, businesses). My Farmer is not the seller of marketplace products, nor a payment intermediary, bank, or payment service provider.
legal_terms_role_body.hr: My Farmer je digitalna platforma koja omogućuje objavu proizvoda, slanje narudžbi i komunikaciju između kupaca i prodavača (farmera, firmi). My Farmer nije prodavač proizvoda na tržnici niti platni posrednik, banka ili pružatelj platnih usluga.

legal_terms_payments_body.en: Payment for marketplace products is arranged and completed solely between buyer and seller (cash, PayPal, bank transfer, or another agreed method). My Farmer does not receive, hold, route, or process money for product orders. The platform does not guarantee payment, refunds, or resolution of payment disputes.
legal_terms_payments_body.hr: Plaćanje za proizvode na tržnici dogovaraju i izvršavaju isključivo kupac i prodavač (gotovina, PayPal, bankovni transfer ili drugi dogovoreni način). My Farmer ne prima, ne drži, ne preusmjerava i ne obrađuje novac za narudžbe proizvoda. Platforma ne jamči izvršenje plaćanja, povrat novca niti rješavanje sporova o plaćanju.

legal_terms_seller_body.en: The seller is responsible for accuracy of prices, quantities, quality, and delivery, for valid payment details in their profile, and for fulfilling orders. The seller is solely responsible for taxes, invoices, and legal obligations related to the sale.
legal_terms_seller_body.hr: Prodavač je odgovoran za točnost cijena, količina, kvalitete i isporuke proizvoda, za valjane podatke za plaćanje u profilu te za ispunjenje narudžbe. Prodavač samostalno odgovara za poreze, račune i zakonske obveze vezan uz prodaju.

legal_terms_buyer_body.en: The buyer is responsible for verifying the seller and product, completing payment as agreed with the seller, and for accurate order details. By confirming an order, the buyer accepts that My Farmer is not a party to the payment.
legal_terms_buyer_body.hr: Kupac je odgovoran za provjeru prodavača i proizvoda, za izvršenje plaćanja dogovoreno s prodavačem te za točnost podataka narudžbe. Potvrđivanjem narudžbe kupac prihvaća da My Farmer nije strana u plaćanju.

legal_terms_premium_body.en: Premium and similar platform services are billed separately via Google Play under Google's terms. This is not payment between buyer and seller for marketplace products.
legal_terms_premium_body.hr: Pretplate Premium i slične usluge platforme naplaćuju se odvojeno putem Google Play trgovine prema uvjetima Googlea. To nije plaćanje između kupca i prodavača za proizvode na tržnici.

legal_terms_disputes_body.en: Disputes regarding products, delivery, or payment are resolved directly between buyer and seller. My Farmer may, but is not required to, assist with communication. The platform is not liable for damage arising from payment or non-performance of contracts between users.
legal_terms_disputes_body.hr: Sporovi u vezi proizvoda, dostave ili plaćanja rješavaju se izravno između kupca i prodavača. My Farmer može, ali nije obvezan, pomoći u komunikaciji. Platforma ne odgovara za štetu nastalu zbog plaćanja ili neispunjenja ugovora između korisnika.

legal_terms_acceptance_body.en: By submitting an order or using payment options in the app, you confirm that you have read and understood that My Farmer has no role in charging between users, and you waive claims against the platform regarding marketplace payments except where law explicitly requires otherwise.
legal_terms_acceptance_body.hr: Slanjem narudžbe ili korištenjem načina plaćanja u aplikaciji potvrđujete da ste pročitali i razumjeli da My Farmer nema ulogu u naplati između korisnika te da se odričete bilo kakvog potraživanja prema platformi u vezi plaćanja na tržnici, osim ako zakon izričito ne nalaže drugačije.

weather_alert_storm.hr: Grmljavina i nepogoda! Po potrebi prekinite rad na polju, učvrstite cerade i zaštitite strojeve.

weather_alert_heavy_rain.en: Heavy rain ({rain}% precipitation)! Check drainage, protect crops and delay spraying.
weather_alert_heavy_rain.hr: Jaka kiša ({rain}% padalina)! Provjerite odvodnju, zaštitite usjeve i odložite prskanje.

farmer_welcome_body.en: I am here to guide you through the app. Whenever you need an explanation on any screen, just tap my icon in the top corner.
farmer_welcome_body.hr: Tu sam da te vodim kroz aplikaciju. Kada god ti zatreba objašnjenje na bilo kojem ekranu, samo klikni na moju ikonu u gornjem kutu.

guide_marketplace_search_body.en: Quickly search for fresh food, seeds, or farm machinery here.
guide_marketplace_search_body.hr: Ovdje možete brzo pretraživati domaću hranu, sjeme ili poljoprivredne mašine.

guide_marketplace_filters_body.en: Use these filters to sort products by distance, type, or growing method.
guide_marketplace_filters_body.hr: Koristite ove filtere za sortiranje proizvoda prema udaljenosti, vrsti ili načinu uzgoja.

guide_marketplace_products_body.en: Tap a product card for details, price, and ordering.
guide_marketplace_products_body.hr: Kliknite na karticu proizvoda za detalje, cijenu i narudžbu.

guide_cart_payment_body.en: Choose how to pay. Coming-soon products require card payment.
guide_cart_payment_body.hr: Odaberite način plaćanja. Za proizvode u dolasku obavezna je kartica.

guide_cart_delivery_body.en: For each farmer, choose farm pickup or delivery to your address.
guide_cart_delivery_body.hr: Za svakog farmera odaberite preuzimanje na farmi ili dostavu na adresu.

guide_cart_checkout_body.en: Review the total and send your order with one tap.
guide_cart_checkout_body.hr: Provjerite ukupni iznos i pošaljite narudžbu jednim klikom.

guide_add_product_image_body.en: Add a clear photo — buyers see the image first.
guide_add_product_image_body.hr: Dodajte jasnu fotografiju — kupci prvo vide sliku, zatim odlučuju.

guide_add_product_details_body.en: Enter name, description, category, and other product details.
guide_add_product_details_body.hr: Unesite naziv, opis, kategoriju i ostale detalje proizvoda.

guide_add_product_submit_body.en: When everything is ready, publish the product to the marketplace.
guide_add_product_submit_body.hr: Kada je sve spremno, objavite proizvod na tržnicu.

guide_product_name_body.en: Enter a clear name (e.g. Homemade honey) so buyers can find you easily.
guide_product_name_body.hr: Upišite jasan naziv (npr. Domaći med ili Mladi luk) kako bi vas kupci lakše pronašli.

guide_product_price_body.en: Enter the unit price. Our system converts it automatically for foreign customers.
guide_product_price_body.hr: Unesite cijenu po jedinici. Naš pametni sustav je automatski preračunava kupcima iz drugih država.

guide_product_stock_body.en: Enter how much you have in stock. The app reduces this after each purchase.
guide_product_stock_body.hr: Upišite koliko otprilike imate robe na stanju. Aplikacija sama smanjuje ovaj broj nakon svake kupnje.

guide_farmer_weather_body.en: Here you will see the forecast and severe weather alerts once you set your farm location in profile.
guide_farmer_weather_body.hr: Ovdje ćete vidjeti prognozu i hitne alarme za nepogode čim unesete lokaciju farme u profilu.

guide_farmer_list_body.en: Track your products, available stock, and use the switch to quickly mark [SOLD OUT].
guide_farmer_list_body.hr: Ovdje pratite svoje proizvode, dostupne kilograme i koristite switch za brzu oznaku [RASPRODANO].

guide_farmer_add_body.en: Tap this plus to open the form and add a new product or premium upcoming item.
guide_farmer_add_body.hr: Kliknite na ovaj plus da otvorite formu i unesete novi proizvod ili premium robu u dolasku.

guide_profile_settings_body.en: Use the dropdown menus here to choose the app language and currency region for marketplace prices.
guide_profile_settings_body.hr: Ovdje iz padajućih izbornika birate jezik aplikacije i valutnu regiju za preračun cijena na tržnici.

guide_profile_tabs_body.en: My Profile manages your business data, while My Gallery lets you share beautiful community moments – your village, garden, plants, animals, and pets.
guide_profile_tabs_body.hr: 'Moj Profil' vam služi za upravljanje poslovnim podacima, dok 'Moja galerija' služi da podijelite lijepe trenutke sa zajednicom – pokažite ljepotu svog sela, predivan vrt, biljke, životinje i kućne ljubimce.

guide_profile_identity_body.en: Your profile photo and name appear here. The orange 'Professional Farmer' badge shows buyers you are a verified, serious producer.
guide_profile_identity_body.hr: Ovdje stoji vaša profilna slika i ime. Narančasta značka 'Profesionalni Farmer' kupcima dokazuje da ste provjereni i ozbiljni proizvođač.

guide_profile_company_identity_body.en: Your company logo and official business name appear here. The gold business badge shows buyers and farmers that you are a verified, trusted supplier.
guide_profile_company_identity_body.hr: Ovdje stoji logotip i službeni naziv vašeg poduzeća. Zlatna poslovna značka kupcima i farmerima dokazuje da ste provjereni, sigurni i ovlašteni dobavljač repromaterijala.

guide_profile_phone_body.en: Enter the number buyers can call to arrange orders and reach you quickly.
guide_profile_phone_body.hr: Unesite broj na koji vas kupci mogu nazvati za dogovor narudžbe i brzu komunikaciju.

guide_profile_address_body.en: Enter your farm location so buyers and the app can find you on the map.
guide_profile_address_body.hr: Upišite lokaciju farme kako bi vas kupci i aplikacija lakše pronašli na karti.

guide_profile_paypal_body.en: Optionally add your PayPal email for faster and safer online payments from buyers.
guide_profile_paypal_body.hr: Opcionalno dodajte PayPal e-mail za brže i sigurnije online plaćanje od kupaca.

guide_profile_land_body.en: Tap here to open the satellite map, draw field boundaries, calculate hectares for free, and start advanced Premium NIRS multispectral crop health monitoring.
guide_profile_land_body.hr: Kliknite ovdje da otvorite satelitsku kartu, prstom ucrtate granice njive, besplatno izračunate hektare i pokrenete napredni Premium NIRS multispektralni nadzor zdravlja biljaka.

guide_profile_farm_number_body.en: Enter your BPG or OPG number that confirms your registered farm business.
guide_profile_farm_number_body.hr: Upišite BPG ili OPG broj koji potvrđuje vaše registrirano poljoprivredno gospodarstvo.

guide_profile_shop_hours_body.en: Turn order availability on, pick working days, and set the hours when you are on the farm for buyers.
guide_profile_shop_hours_body.hr: Uključite dostupnost za narudžbe, odaberite radne dane i satnice kada ste na imanju i dostupni kupcima.

guide_profile_min_order_body.en: Set the minimum amount in euros a buyer must spend before you personally pack and deliver the products.
guide_profile_min_order_body.hr: Postavite najmanji iznos u eurima koji kupac mora potrošiti da biste mu vi osobno spakovali i dostavili proizvode.

guide_profile_pickup_body.en: Specify the days and exact hours when buyers can drive to your farm themselves to pick up their orders.
guide_profile_pickup_body.hr: Navedite dane i točne sate kada kupci mogu sami automobilom doći kod vas na imanje po svoje narudžbe.

guide_profile_delivery_info_body.en: Enter a short description for buyers about how and when you personally deliver goods (e.g. which days you drive).
guide_profile_delivery_info_body.hr: Ovdje upišite kratak tekstualni opis za kupce o tome kako i kada vršite lični prevoz robe (npr. kojim danima vozite).

guide_profile_delivery_zones_body.en: Set the minimum order amount for each distance so you know when it is worth driving personally to deliver within that zone.
guide_profile_delivery_zones_body.hr: Ovdje određujete minimalni iznos narudžbe za svaku udaljenost kako biste znali kada vam se isplati lično sjesti u auto i odvesti robu kupcu unutar te zone.

guide_animals_list_body.en: Here you see all your animals sorted by species, numbers, and categories.
guide_animals_list_body.hr: Ovdje vidite sve vaše životinje razvrstane po vrstama, brojevima i kategorijama.

guide_animals_records_body.en: Track important data, vet check-ups, and vaccination history for each animal here.
guide_animals_records_body.hr: Ovdje pratite važne podatke, preglede veterinara i povijest cijepljenja za svako pojedino grlo.

guide_animals_add_body.en: Tap this green plus to open the form and register a new animal in your database.
guide_animals_add_body.hr: Kliknite na ovaj zeleni plus kako biste otvorili formu i registrirali novo grlo u svoju bazu.

guide_add_animal_photo_body.en: Tap here to take a photo with the camera or pick an image from the gallery for easier identification.
guide_add_animal_photo_body.hr: Kliknite ovdje da uslikate životinju kamerom ili izaberete sliku iz galerije radi lakšeg prepoznavanja.

guide_add_animal_identity_body.en: Enter the animal name or ear-tag number, then choose the livestock type from the dropdown below.
guide_add_animal_identity_body.hr: Upišite ime životinje ili broj ušne markice, a ispod izaberite vrstu stoke iz padajućeg izbornika.

guide_add_animal_health_body.en: Enter the animal age and use the large field for medical notes, vaccination history, or vet advice.
guide_add_animal_health_body.hr: Unesite starost životinje, a u veliko polje upišite medicinske bilješke, povijest cijepljenja ili savjete veterinara.

guide_add_animal_documents_body.en: Tap here to photograph and attach vet papers, vaccination records, or medical reports for this animal.
guide_add_animal_documents_body.hr: Ovdje kliknite ako želite uslikati i priložiti papire od veterinara, knjižicu cijepljenja ili nalaze za ovu životinju.

guide_add_animal_save_body.en: Tap this button to permanently save the data and open the animal digital health record.
guide_add_animal_save_body.hr: Kliknite na ovaj gumb da trajno spremite podatke i otvorite digitalni zdravstveni karton životinje.

land_premium_desc.en: Activate Premium Pro for €9.99 per month. Up to 50 parcels with full NIRS/NDVI satellite monitoring, Agro-Alarms for severe weather over your fields, up to 500 livestock with document attachments, and 60 AI scans per month!
land_premium_desc.hr: Aktivirajte Premium Pro za 9,99 € mjesečno. Do 50 parcela s punim NIRS/NDVI satelitskim nadzorom, Agro-Alarmi za nepogode iznad vaših njiva, do 500 životinja stoke s privitcima dokumenata i 60 AI skeniranja mjesečno!

land_tap_hint.en: Tap the map to place points. Drag markers to adjust boundaries precisely.
land_tap_hint.hr: Dodirnite kartu da postavite točke. Povucite marker da precizno pomjerite granicu.

land_map_compact_hint.en: Tap the map to draw on full screen.
land_map_compact_hint.hr: Dodirnite kartu za crtanje preko cijelog ekrana.

land_nirs_premium_body.en: This advanced satellite monitoring of crop health and soil moisture (NIRS/NDVI) is available only to Premium members. Activate Premium Pro and track crop status live with Sentinel-2 satellite data!
land_nirs_premium_body.hr: Napredni NIRS/NDVI satelitski nadzor dostupan je u Premium paketu: Hobi Farmer — 20 učitavanja/mj, Profesionalni Farmer Pro — 50 učitavanja/mj. Aktivirajte pretplatu i pratite stanje usjeva sa Sentinel-2 satelita!

land_nirs_coming_soon.en: NIRS/NDVI monitoring will open for this parcel. Sentinel-2 data coming soon.
land_nirs_coming_soon.hr: NIRS/NDVI nadzor se otvara za ovu parcelu. Podaci sa Sentinel-2 satelita uskoro stižu.

land_nirs_quota_remaining.en: Available NIRS satellite scans this month: {remaining} / {limit}
land_nirs_quota_remaining.hr: Dostupnih NIRS satelitskih nadzora za ovaj mjesec: {remaining} / {limit}

land_nirs_limit_monthly.en: You have used all NIRS satellite scans for this month.
land_nirs_limit_monthly.hr: Iskoristili ste sve NIRS satelitske nadzore za ovaj mjesec.

land_nirs_subscription_required.en: NIRS satellite monitoring requires a Premium subscription.
land_nirs_subscription_required.hr: NIRS satelitski nadzor zahtijeva Premium pretplatu.

land_nirs_close_parcel_first.en: Close the parcel first before loading the NIRS/NDVI map.
land_nirs_close_parcel_first.hr: Prvo zatvorite parcelu prije učitavanja NIRS/NDVI karte.

land_nirs_load_body.en: Load Sentinel-2 NIRS/NDVI monitoring for the closed parcel? Each load uses 1 monthly scan.
land_nirs_load_body.hr: Učitati Sentinel-2 NIRS/NDVI nadzor za zatvorenu parcelu? Svako učitavanje koristi 1 od mjesečnih nadzora.

land_nirs_load_success.en: NIRS/NDVI analysis is ready. View results on the map.
land_nirs_load_success.hr: NIRS/NDVI analiza je spremna. Pregledajte rezultate na karti.

land_nirs_imagery_stale.en: Satellite imagery is {days} days old. Sentinel-2 revisits the same area about every 5 days — run again later for a fresher scene.

land_nirs_basemap_note.en: The Google Maps satellite background may be older than the NIRS overlay data.

land_nirs_no_scan_yet.en: No NIRS/NDVI scan for this parcel yet. Start monitoring with the button below.
land_nirs_no_scan_yet.hr: Još nema NIRS/NDVI snimke za ovu parcelu. Pokrenite nadzor gumbom ispod.

land_nirs_simulation_badge.en: Simulation — enable live API before production
land_nirs_simulation_badge.hr: Simulacija — uključite stvarni API prije produkcije

land_nirs_advice_good.en: Vegetation is in good condition. Continue weekly monitoring.
land_nirs_advice_good.hr: Vegetacija je u dobrom stanju. Nastavite redoviti nadzor jednom tjedno.

land_nirs_advice_moderate.en: Vegetation is moderate. Check irrigation and seed density in 3–5 days.
land_nirs_advice_moderate.hr: Vegetacija je umjerena. Provjerite navodnjavanje i gustoću sijanja u sljedećih 3–5 dana.

land_nirs_advice_low.en: Low NDVI — check irrigation, fertilization and possible field diseases.
land_nirs_advice_low.hr: Nizak NDVI — provjerite navodnjavanje, hranidbu i moguće bolesti na terenu.

land_nirs_advice_low_moisture.en: Soil moisture is low. Plan irrigation in the next 24–48 hours.
land_nirs_advice_low_moisture.hr: Vlažnost tla je niska. Planirajte navodnjavanje u sljedećih 24–48 sati.

land_nirs_advice_high_moisture.en: Soil is very wet. Delay irrigation and watch for moisture-related diseases.
land_nirs_advice_high_moisture.hr: Tlo je vrlo vlažno. Odgodite navodnjavanje i pripazite na bolesti uslijed vlage.

land_nirs_compare_up.en: NDVI increased by {delta} — vegetation is improving.
land_nirs_compare_up.hr: NDVI porastao za {delta} — vegetacija se poboljšava.

land_nirs_compare_down.en: NDVI dropped by {delta} — check the parcel in the field.
land_nirs_compare_down.hr: NDVI pao za {delta} — provjerite parcelu na terenu.

land_nirs_compare_stable.en: NDVI stable compared to the previous scan.
land_nirs_compare_stable.hr: NDVI stabilan u odnosu na prethodni sken.

guide_land_nirs_quota_body.en: Here you can see how many NIRS satellite scans remain this month. Your drawn parcels are stored for one year.
guide_land_nirs_quota_body.hr: Ovdje pratite koliko vam je preostalo dostupnih NIRS satelitskih nadzora za ovaj mjesec unutar vašeg paketa. Povijest vaših iscrtanih parcela sustav čuva točno godinu dana.

land_draw_hint.en: Draw at least 3 points and close the parcel to calculate area.
land_draw_hint.hr: Ucrtajte najmanje 3 točke i zatvorite parcelu za izračun površine.

land_closed_hint.en: Parcel is closed. Drag points to fine-tune boundaries.
land_closed_hint.hr: Parcela je zatvorena. Povucite točke za finu korekciju granica.

land_self_intersect.en: Lines cross each other. Adjust points and close the parcel again.
land_self_intersect.hr: Linije se presijecaju. Pomjerite točke pa ponovno zatvorite parcelu.

land_min_points.hr: Potrebne su najmanje 3 točke za parcelu.

paywall_pharmacy_benefit_scanner.en: AI Plant Scanner — {count} scans per month
paywall_pharmacy_benefit_scanner.hr: AI Plant Scanner — {count} scans per month

account_deletion_confirm_body.en:
This will permanently delete your profile, payment methods, and listings.

If you have an active subscription, your account will remain until the end of the current billing period. Premium stays active until then; cancel renewal separately in Google Play if needed.

This action cannot be undone after deletion completes.
account_deletion_confirm_body.hr:
Ovo će trajno obrisati vaš profil, načine plaćanja i proizvode u izlogu.

Ako imate aktivnu pretplatu, račun ostaje do kraja tekućeg obračunskog razdoblja. Premium funkcije tada i dalje možete koristiti; za otkaz obnove idite u Google Play.

Nakon završetka brisanja akcija se ne može poništiti.

account_deletion_tile_subtitle.en: Permanently remove your profile and data

account_deletion_pending_generic.en: Your account is scheduled for deletion after your subscription ends.
account_deletion_pending_generic.hr: Račun je zakazan za brisanje nakon isteka pretplate.

account_deletion_pending_until.en: Your account will be permanently deleted on {date}. Until then you can still use Premium features you paid for.
account_deletion_pending_until.hr: Račun će biti trajno obrisan {date}. Do tada možete koristiti Premium funkcije koje ste platili.

account_deletion_failed.en: Could not delete account. Please try again.
account_deletion_failed.hr: Brisanje računa nije uspjelo. Pokušajte ponovo.

account_deletion_already_requested.en: Account deletion has already been requested.

account_deletion_admin_blocked.en: Admin accounts cannot be deleted from the app.
account_deletion_admin_blocked.hr: Admin računi se ne mogu obrisati iz aplikacije.

account_deletion_login_required.en: Please sign in again to delete your account.
account_deletion_login_required.hr: Prijavite se ponovo da biste obrisali račun.

privacy_policy_subtitle.en: How My Farmer handles your data
privacy_policy_subtitle.hr: Kako My Farmer koristi vaše podatke

privacy_policy_intro.en: This policy explains what we collect, why we use it, and your rights. My Farmer is a marketplace platform — peer-to-peer payments between buyers and sellers are not processed by us.
privacy_policy_intro.hr: Ova politika objašnjava što prikupljamo, zašto to radimo i koja su vaša prava. My Farmer je platforma za tržnicu — plaćanja između kupca i prodavača ne procesiramo mi.

privacy_policy_profile_subtitle.en: Data collection, location, and your rights
privacy_policy_profile_subtitle.hr: Prikupljanje podataka, lokacija i vaša prava

privacy_policy_web_failed.en: Could not open the privacy policy link.
privacy_policy_web_failed.hr: Nije moguće otvoriti link politike privatnosti.

privacy_policy_footer.en: Last updated: July 2026. We may update this policy; significant changes will be shown in the app.
privacy_policy_footer.hr: Zadnje ažuriranje: srpanj 2026. Politiku možemo povremeno ažurirati; značajne promjene bit će prikazane u aplikaciji.

privacy_controller_body.en: My Farmer (com.myfarmer.network) operates this app. For privacy requests contact us at the email below.
privacy_controller_body.hr: My Farmer (com.myfarmer.network) upravlja ovom aplikacijom. Za zahtjeve vezane uz privatnost kontaktirajte nas na email ispod.

privacy_data_body.en:
Account: name, email, phone, address, role, farm or business details.

Usage: products, orders, chat messages, animal records, land parcels, scan history, payment methods you save (PayPal email, masked card digits, IBAN).

Device: FCM token for notifications, device ID for trial scan limits.

Media & sensors: photos you upload, camera for plant scanner, GPS for marketplace pricing and farm location.
privacy_data_body.hr:
Račun: ime, email, telefon, adresa, uloga, podaci o gospodarstvu ili firmi.

Korištenje: proizvodi, narudžbe, chat poruke, kartoni životinja, parcele, povijest skeniranja, načini plaćanja koje spremite (PayPal email, zadnje 4 znamenke kartice, IBAN).

Uređaj: FCM token za obavijesti, ID uređaja za limite probnih skenova.

Mediji i senzori: fotografije koje uploadate, kamera za AI skener, GPS za cijene na tržnici i lokaciju farme.

privacy_purpose_body.en: To provide the marketplace, chat, vet services, plant scanner, satellite parcel tools, weather alerts, Premium subscriptions via Google Play, and to prevent abuse. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy_purpose_body.hr: Za pružanje tržnice, chata, veterinarskih usluga, AI skenera, satelitskih alata, vremenskih upozorenja, Premium pretplata putem Google Playa i sprječavanja zloupotrebe. Vaše osobne podatke ne prodajemo.

privacy_location_body.en: GPS is used to show nearby products, correct currency/pricing for your region, and farm coordinates you choose to share. You can deny location permission; some features will be limited.
privacy_location_body.hr: GPS koristimo za prikaz obližnjih proizvoda, ispravnu valutu/cijene za vašu regiju i koordinate farme koje sami odaberete. Možete odbiti dozvolu za lokaciju; neke funkcije tada neće raditi.

privacy_third_parties_body.en: We use Google Firebase (auth, database, storage, push), Google Play / RevenueCat (subscriptions), Google Maps, Open-Meteo (weather), Plant.id and Sentinel Hub (via our servers for scans and NIRS). Each provider has its own privacy terms.
privacy_third_parties_body.hr: Koristimo Google Firebase (auth, baza, storage, push), Google Play / RevenueCat (pretplate), Google Maps, Open-Meteo (vrijeme), Plant.id i Sentinel Hub (preko naših servera za sken i NIRS). Svaki pružatelj ima vlastite uvjete privatnosti.

privacy_retention_body.en: We keep data while your account is active. When you delete your account, personal data is removed or anonymized; some order records may be kept briefly for dispute resolution. Active subscriptions delay full deletion until the paid period ends.
privacy_retention_body.hr: Podatke čuvamo dok je račun aktivan. Kad obrišete račun, osobni podaci se uklanjaju ili anonimiziraju; neki zapisi o narudžbama mogu se kratko zadržati radi sporova. Aktivna pretplata odgađa potpuno brisanje do kraja plaćenog razdoblja.

privacy_rights_body.en: You may access, correct, or delete your data. Use Profile → Delete account, or contact us. EU users have GDPR rights including data portability and objection. You may lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.
privacy_rights_body.hr: Možete pristupiti, ispraviti ili obrisati svoje podatke. Koristite Profil → Obriši račun ili nas kontaktirajte. Korisnici u EU imaju GDPR prava uključujući prenosivost i prigovor. Možete podnijeti pritužbu nadležnom tijelu.

privacy_security_body.en: Data is transmitted over HTTPS and stored in Firebase with access rules. Payment card numbers are not stored in full — only masked details you enter for seller profiles. Keep your password confidential.
privacy_security_body.hr: Podaci se prenose preko HTTPS-a i pohranjuju u Firebaseu s pravilima pristupa. Pun broj kartice ne pohranjujemo — samo maskirane podatke koje unesete u profil prodavača. Čuvajte lozinku povjerljivo.

registration_legal_consent_required.en: Please accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy to register.
registration_legal_consent_required.hr: Prihvatite uvjete korištenja i politiku privatnosti za registraciju.
